messages:
maya: Morning! Quick shout — we just crossed 3.5M monthly requests 🎉🔥
alex: woahhh that's huge :tada: congrats team
ryan: omg the queue dashboard looks like confetti
sasha: rooftop kite + gong? also who wants donuts
jia: count me in for rooftop. can we do 11:30? (i have client call at 1)
tom: i'll bring the portable speaker and a kazoo. who has a kite? :)
eva: i have a tiny kite in desk B7 (don't ask). also made a tiny banner: "3.5M & climbing"
maya: love it. poll: rooftop at 11:30, pizza afterwards? react with :+1: for yes, :pizza: for pizza only, :wave: if remote rally
alex: :+1: (added :tada:)
ryan: :pizza:
sasha: :wave: I'll be remote, can we Zoom it? GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-3.5M
celebration-bot: Congratulations! :confetti_ball: Automatic message — milestone_badge: "3.5M-monthly-requests"
jia: can ops bring a small gong? (we used the gong at launch 2.0 and it was epic)
tom: ordering logistics: i'll grab 4 boxes of mini pies from LaPizzeria. dietary: veg/vegan/allergic?
eva: i'm vegan, allergy: peanuts
maya: noted. I'll post RSVP thread in #all-hands so people outside random can join. Also tiny thank you to infra team — they tuned caching and saved us 18% on token spend. big kudos!
alex: shoutout infra team!! :clap: :clap:
ryan: any merch to mark this? mini stickers for kites?
sasha: I made a 3.5M sticker design, will share in #design in 10
maya: perfect. Also quick for the docs folks: milestone blurb for the blog? 2 lines and I'll paste into the release notes
jia: "Redwood Inference surpasses 3.5M monthly requests; caching and routing improvements improve cost and latency." short enough?
maya: perfect — thanks. ok team: rooftop at 11:30, mini kite parade, gong at noon, pizza after. RSVP or react.
tom: :thumbsup: see you there!
eva: 🌱🪁
alex: :heart_eyes:
